title: Custom Model
help: Enable custom model mode before validating stream values in process and basic views.
steps: Open the above Etoh1 project, go to Tools-Preference-Process Tab. Select "Activate Custom Model" and OK the preference window.

The Data is from streams: ICP-REF and ICP-REFEX. In the Project Process View, double click the component "TOWER-reflux pump" and find the Reflux pump streams. Go to the Project Basic View and click Streams to select ICP-REFEX ICP-REF stream. Note down the values of Liquid flow rate, Design gauge pressure, Design temperature.
